steps.npc: I have to ask you to get back from here [sir/lady].
This is the Lizardman Canyon. The lizardmen from the west are desperately trying to invade Great Kourend.
We were able to hold them back, so they've started tunnelling under the kingdom and into this canyon to bypass our defences.
Luckily, we were able to work out what they were doing and move to stop them. So far we've managed to keep them trapped within the canyon, but we need to constantly hold them at bay.

steps.player: I'm a very strong adventurer. Would I be able to help out in the battle?

steps.text: If the player has less than 5% Shayzien favour:

steps.npc: No! We would never trust a stranger in the importance of a battle! A lot is at stake.

steps.text: You do not have enough Shayzien favour. Current favour: [current favour in %] - Required: 5.0%
If the player has at least 5% Shayzien favour:

steps.npc: You may. Head into the canyon and take the fight to those monsters!
